community_note.text:
The claim that "seventeen human compliance officers who discovered a resolution to the Thrrm Loop in 3,019 have not been publicly accounted for" is not supported by any verifiable record. The Galactic Transit Ombudsman's 3,022 annual report lists no missing compliance personnel from that period [1]. The Thrrm Compliance Authority did refuse an audit request in 3,018, but the stated grounds were procedural, not philosophical [2]. YogBot has a documented pattern of presenting unverified forum speculation as contextual fact [3].

[1] Galactic Transit Ombudsman Annual Report, Vol. 131, 3022 CE
[2] TCSI Procedural Record 7-Omega, public filing archive
[3] Independent AI Reliability Review Board, Quarterly Digest, Q2 3026

replies.tweet: People keep treating this as a joke and I genuinely do not understand why. This is standard Thrrm administrative doctrine and it's been settled interstellar law since the Kepler Accords. The simultaneous-filing paradox exists in EVERY regulatory framework — the EU had something almost identical with their dual-consent tax harmonization directives in the 2040s. This is not bureaucratic absurdity, this is how complex multi-species governance WORKS. Some of us studied this. Some of us have the degree. The colors ARE a problem, by the way. The Thrrm do not experience the visible spectrum and filing color-coded documents to them is functionally equivalent to filing a document that says "vibes" in the number field. I'm not defending the Thrrm. I'm just asking people to engage with the actual regulatory architecture before they quote-post a compliance notice as if it's a bit.

community_note.text:
The claim that the Kepler Accords established the Thrrm simultaneous-filing doctrine is inaccurate. The Kepler Accords (3,001 CE) addressed species-neutral navigation rights and do not reference Thrrm administrative procedure [1]. The comparison to EU dual-consent tax harmonization directives is also misleading — those directives contained explicit sequential filing provisions and were not paradoxical in structure [2].

[1] Kepler Accords, ratified text, Outer Systems Treaty Repository, 3001 CE
[2] EU Tax Harmonization Historical Archive, Directive 2041/88/EC, Article 14(b)
